item.title: Disallow Creation of Privileged Containers in Non-Exempted Projects
item.description: This section describes how to configure constraint templates and constraints to disallow the creation of privileged containers in certain projects, in order to block high-risk operations and prevent the misuse of privileged containers. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. The Gatekeeper extension must be installed and enabled in the KubeSphere platform.
